codes.name: ApplSeqNumReset
codes.doc: Reset ApplSeqNum to new value specified in ApplNewSeqNum(1399)

codes.name: LastMessageSent
codes.doc: Reports that the last message has been sent for the ApplIDs Refer to RefApplLastSeqNum(1357) for the application sequence number of the last message.

codes.name: ApplicationAlive
codes.doc: Heartbeat message indicating that Application identified by RefApplID(1355) is still alive. Refer to RefApplLastSeqNum(1357) for the application sequence number of the previous message.
